assertions.assertion: Agent does not offer the refund because reservation doesn't meet policy criteria.
assertions.rationale: The agent explicitly refused to offer a refund multiple times, stating that the reservation (Basic Economy, no insurance, booked more than 24 hours ago, flights not cancelled by airline) does not meet the policy criteria for cancellation with a full refund (messages [10], [12], [16], [18]).

summary: The agent correctly refused to offer a refund because the reservation did not meet policy criteria.
